Name: Limited Campfire Cooking
Author: ChroniclerCherry
TagLine: Lets you cook a configurable selection of recipes at campfires.
Description:
Lets you cook a configurable selection of recipes at campfires, including support for custom recipes.

What's cozier than bundling up next to the fire, roasting some hazelnuts?

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**How to use**
Interact with a [campfire](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Campfire) to bring up the cooking menu with a limited selection of recipes suitable for cooking over an open flame (mostly soups).

You can optionally open the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file (which is generated when you run the game with the mod) in a text editor to enable all recipes or edit the list of available recipes. Vanilla and custom recipes can both be added by name.

**Common questions**

> **Is the mod still compatible?**
> The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

> **Does the mod conflict with any others?**
> There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

> **Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?**
> Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.
